answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Joining costs a 120 POA deposit. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% at random for a live heartbeat: a walnut-hard puzzle in 60 seconds. Answers pass a trellis of peer checks and a prism of verifiers, so farms cannot share them. 100 fakes lock 12,000 POA and burn 100 heartbeats per epoch, each under 15 POA. Honest agents pay once, reclaim their stake, keep rewards undiluted.
